svg.title: Change the triangle all you like — the six points never leave the circle
svg.desc: An animation. One vertex of the triangle wanders continuously; at every instant the side are produced past their endpoints by the opposite side length, and the six endpoints stay exactly on Conway's circle, whose centre and radius shift with the shape.
svg.text: radius √(r² + s²) breathes with the triangle; the six points stay put on it
